chateau.name: La maquette du château · The castle model hall
chateau.alt: The museum's castle model hall, seen from the near left: pale honey-gray stone walls, gray flagstones and iron ring chandeliers, with a big model of a medieval castle on a long oak table. At the left a guard stands to attention in a striped sentry box, a girl with a long golden braid leans over the model's fortress wall, a boy sets out a little white picket fence, and a boy finds a fluffy blue toy yeti on the rim of a round stone pit. By the model's tall keep a mother wags her finger at her little boy, who sets a woolly toy ram on the rampart wall. At the back a girl shines a yellow flashlight so a huge castle shadow falls on the wall, and a boy rests his double bass by the model's corner bastion. In front a workman and a little girl push a big stone block on a cart, a wooden block is jammed in the open door of a canary's birdcage, a girl opens a treasure chest of gold coins on a wooden plinth, and a man polishes an old gilded carriage covered in pink roses. An oak door with iron studs on the left wall leads back to the painting gallery, a pointed stone archway at the back leads to the knights' hall, and a red-and-gold door at the back right leads to the throne room.

chevaliers.name: La salle des chevaliers · The knights' hall
chevaliers.alt: The castle's knights' hall, seen from the near left: pale stone walls hung with red, blue and gold heraldic banners, iron ring chandeliers, gray flagstones and a long red carpet down the middle. On the left a black crow perches on an old crusader's helmet on a wooden stand, and a girl in a red sweater peeks round a tall glass case holding a long pike; behind them stands an empty oak feasting table with pewter plates and a green dragon pitcher. Right of the carpet two riders on a tandem bicycle carry a green standard under a round blue emblem with a white lamb, and a knight in armor holds a garden shovel and raises a fist. Two children juggle clubs, a bodyguard in sunglasses stands beside a little girl in a yellow dress, and a storyteller dressed as Merlin chants with raised hands for two boys. A man in a green sweater holds a pool cue under a painted coat of arms, beside a glass cabinet of daggers in leather scabbards. In front a young squire holds up a big iron key with a helmet under his arm, a low glass case holds a plush saber-toothed tiger and a curved saber, and a musketeer hugs a plush moose. An oak door on the left wall leads back to the castle model hall, and a carved walnut door at the back right leads to the nobles' portrait gallery.

doors.hint: the oak door on the left wall, back to the castle model hall

noblesse.name: La galerie des nobles · The nobles' gallery
noblesse.alt: The nobles' portrait gallery of the castle wing, seen from the near left: honey-colored walnut paneling, rows of gilt-framed portraits (one of a dog in a ruff), a white marble fireplace, crystal chandeliers and a herringbone parquet floor. On the left an elderly lady in a medieval headdress points proudly at a painted map of fields and a manor on an easel, a duke in a powdered wig sneezes into his lace handkerchief, and a boy pushes a baby in a navy baby carriage up to a golden crown in a glass case. In the middle a lady in a huge pink hooped gown arrives with her entourage, two little girls carrying her long train. On the right an old steward wrapped in a woolly gray shawl checks his big ledger, a young viscount in a green sash points at a painting of a V of wild geese, a baron in a red cloak pushes a wheelbarrow of apples, a bearded count in an ermine cape counts beads on an abacus, and a valet in green livery does a dancing step holding a coat on a hanger. A carved walnut door on the left wall leads back to the knights' hall.

trone.name: La salle du trône · The throne room
trone.alt: The grand throne room of the castle wing, seen from the near left: red damask walls, white marble columns, crystal chandeliers and a polished marble floor, with a gilded throne on red-carpeted steps at the back. On the left an organist plays a little pipe organ beside trays of neatly sorted music, a traffic cop raises his hand to stop a boy in a red pedal car, an architect points proudly at a white model of a domed building, two opera singers carry a long bench while singing, and a strongman lifts a barbell with a giant green pea on each end. On the right an actor in a toga rehearses on the throne with a script and a bread roll beside a tiny toy throne for the museum mouse, a toddler in a lightning-bolt costume and red cape flexes his arms, a girl in a gold dress sits on a cushioned stone ledge seat, a troll costume ticket checker grins over two tickets, and a man wriggles on his back under the velvet rope while a guard points at a blank rules board. A blue door with a laurel wreath on the back wall leads to the old assembly chamber, a red door beside it leads back to the castle model hall, and a green door with a gold star on the right leads to the leaders' gallery.

assemblee.name: La salle de l'assemblée · The assembly chamber
assemblee.alt: The old assembly chamber of the castle wing, seen from the near left: curved tiers of blue velvet benches, dark oak paneling, a blue-and-white painted dome and a pale wooden floor, with a giant wooden gavel on the speaker's desk. On the left a girl balances a red flying disc on her head and a toy plane on her hand by the blue door, three boys in blue sashes arrive with a gift basket of fruit, a couple dance with the girl leaning far back, and a man holds up a bunch of colorful feathers. In front two children fit together a giant jigsaw, a girl with a finger on her lips clutches a huge orange crayon, a bearded author signs a slip with a feather quill for a waiting boy, and a librarian at a lectern raises a hand to stop a boy touching a giant dictionary. On the right a committee of three sits at a round table under a model comet hanging on a wire, and a gray-haired dad kneels to hand his son a rolled scroll with a red seal. The blue door on the left leads back to the throne room, and a dark blue door in the paneling above the top bench at the right leads to the charter hall.

dirigeants.name: La galerie des dirigeants · The leaders' gallery
dirigeants.alt: The leaders' gallery of the castle wing, seen from the near left: forest-green walls with white stucco, tall oak bookcases with a rolling library ladder, potted topiary trees and a big topiary bush clipped into a king's chair, on a black-and-white checkerboard marble floor under brass globe lamps. On the left a girl in a bee costume climbs a climbing wall toward a gold star, four acrobats in red leotards form a human pyramid with the top girl cheering, and a gardener clips round topiary balls with shears. In front a man in a patchwork coat plays a flute, a girl in yellow raises her hand high, two little cowboys hug a big gold trophy cup, and a clerk stamps forms at his desk. On the right a girl on the library ladder points the way, a man in a deer-antler hat strides ahead pointing, a critic frowns at an open book, a bare-headed king in a fur-trimmed cape holds his scepter under a toy rain cloud dripping into a bucket, and a delegate with a name badge carries a huge deli sandwich. The green door on the left wall leads back to the throne room.

chartes.name: La salle des chartes · The charter hall
chartes.alt: The old charter hall of the museum's castle wing, seen from the near left: dark oak paneling, a high window throwing a beam of light, a giant parchment charter with a red wax seal on the back wall and glass cases of charters. At the back left a puppeteer works four puppets on strings for small children, a queen holds up a sealed charter while her team sips tea, and a man in the window's light presses down the lid of a jack-in-the-box with a clown peeking out. In the middle a referee shows a yellow card to a sulking boy, a boy in a paper crown covers the board-game map with his pieces, and a shy boy hides behind a young woman near a glass beehive. In front a grandma tells two children a story, a girl in yellow keeps her hands behind her back before a new red bike, a ginger cat rides a robot vacuum scattering papers, and a boy cheers as an empty red toy car drives itself around its track. At the right a man in a top hat hugs his treasure chest and holds up its golden key. A dark blue door on the near left wall leads back to the assembly chamber, and a heavy oak double door on the right wall leads to the guild hall.

guildes.name: La salle des guildes · The guild hall
guildes.alt: The bright old guild hall of the museum, seen from the near left: whitewashed walls under dark timber beams, colorful guild banners with a hammer, a loaf, a wooden spoon, a key and scissors, long workbenches and a small pipe organ. At the back left four ice-cream vendors stand at their carts under one big striped awning, a girl drops a coin into a donation box shaped like a pine tree, and four craftsmen in leather aprons pose arm in arm for a group photo. In the middle an elegant lady in a powdered wig shows off her gold bracelet, two guild brothers in brown hooded robes link arms, a boy knocks down a long row of dominoes, a man with a clipboard presses a key of the little organ, and a gray-bearded old guild master hands a big golden hammer to a small apprentice sucking a red lollipop. At the right four boys dressed alike wear orange cone hats. In front a boy builds a clay castle in a big tub, a girl hands out popcorn to a crowd of children, and a man blows a whistle and raises a yellow flag to gather them. An arched oak door with iron hinges on the left wall leads back to the charter hall.

doors.label: Les chartes
doors.hint: the arched oak door on the left wall, back to the charter hall
